rows.values: default · focus · filled · disabled · invalid · focus-invalid
rows.code: no prop — live state: focus = :focus-visible · filled = value / defaultValue set · disabled = disabled · invalid = aria-invalid · focus-invalid = focus + invalid
placeholder: string — hint shown while the box is empty
defaultValue: string | number | readonly string[] — initial value when uncontrolled; in Figma the filled boolean shows the value layer (Textarea has no separate controlled value prop)
rows: number — initial visible rows; the box still auto-grows with content, not modeled as a Figma control

no prop — live state: focus = :focus-visible on the control · disabled = disabled · invalid = aria-invalid on the control · focus-invalid = focus + invalid (has-[] selectors bubble from the control up to the group)
no prop — live state: vertical = an addon with align block-start/block-end or a textarea child; horizontal = default
children — the group’s content region (the control + addons)
size on SelectTrigger — default · sm, the trigger height
no prop — live state: focus = :focus-visible · disabled = disabled · invalid = aria-invalid · focus-invalid = focus + invalid (no filled state, unlike Input/Textarea)
placeholder on SelectValue — shown while no value is selected
value / defaultValue — shows the currently selected item's label; value is controlled, defaultValue uncontrolled
no prop — live state: on = value / defaultValue set (Figma property name is a typo for "filled", not renamed here)
onValueChange: (value: string) => void — called when the selection changes
open: boolean — controlled open state; Figma is a static composition and can’t represent live open/close (see the Open example)
defaultOpen: boolean — open state when uncontrolled; default false
onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void — called when the dropdown opens or closes
required: boolean — marks the select required for native form validation; default false, no visual difference
name: string — form field name submitted with the form; no visual representation
children — the caption text
no prop — live state: disabled = peer-disabled / group-data-[disabled=true] set by the paired control, not a Label prop
htmlFor: string — the id of the control this label names, sets the native for association
orientation: 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'responsive' — default "vertical"; a cva axis (responsive is a code-only third value, container-query driven)
no prop — live state: true = aria-invalid set on the control (Field itself carries no invalid prop)
nothing in code — Figma-only axis, real only for horizontal orientation; code composes control-leading via child order
children — the child here is a FieldLabel (usually wrapping a Label)
children — the child here is the control (Input, Textarea, Select …)
children — the child here is a FieldDescription

nothing in code — Figma-only visibility toggle; FieldDescription is simply omitted from JSX when not needed
nothing in code — Figma-only visibility toggle; FieldError is simply omitted/conditionally rendered
